Lead the global IT organization, establishing clear priorities, operating models, performance metrics, and accountability. Serve as a trusted technology advisor to the executive leadership team and senior business stakeholders. Develop a scalable global IT operating model supporting a distributed and remote workforce. Establish technology standards, policies, architecture principles, and governance frameworks across the organization. Infrastructure, Cloud & Enterprise Technology Oversee global infrastructure, cloud platforms, networks, identity and access management, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, and enterprise applications. Drive modernization of FalconX’s IT environment through cloud adoption, automation, observability, and technology standardization. Ensure highly available and resilient technology services supporting a global, 24/7 business. Establish robust disaster recovery, business continuity, and technology resilience capabilities. Evaluate and implement emerging technologies that can improve operational efficiency and employee productivity. Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance Partner closely with the Security organization to ensure IT infrastructure and enterprise systems meet rigorous security standards. Establish strong IT controls, governance, risk management, and compliance processes appropriate for a financial technology environment. Support internal and external audits and ensure appropriate technology controls are consistently maintained. Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Security teams to manage technology-related operational and regulatory risks. Maintain strong controls around identity, privileged access, data protection, third-party technology providers, and sensitive corporate systems. Enterprise Applications & Digital Workplace Lead the strategy and lifecycle management of enterprise applications, including business systems, productivity platforms, collaboration tools, and corporate technology. Build a modern digital workplace experience for a globally distributed workforce. Improve employee productivity through automation, self-service capabilities, AI-enabled workflows, and integrated enterprise platforms. Establish effective vendor management and technology procurement strategies. Organizational Leadership Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing global IT leadership team. Establish a culture of ownership, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and customer service. Develop organizational capabilities and succession plans to support FalconX’s continued growth. Manage global technology budgets, investments, vendors, and strategic partnerships. Create meaningful KPIs and service-level objectives to measure IT performance and business impact. What We're Looking For 15+ years of progressive experience in Information Technology, Enterprise Technology, Infrastructure, or a related field, including significant executive leadership experience. Experience managing distributed and geographically diverse technology teams. Strong expertise across cloud infrastructure, networking, enterprise applications, identity and access management, endpoint management, IT operations, and technology governance. Demonstrated experience building scalable IT operating models and modernizing legacy technology environments. Strong understanding of cybersecurity, technology risk, business continuity, disaster recovery, and regulatory requirements. Experience operating in highly available, mission-critical, or 24/7 environments. Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with C-level executives and cross-functional leadership teams. Strong financial and vendor management skills, including ownership of significant technology budgets and strategic technology partnerships. Exceptional communication, organizational, and people-leadership skills. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline; advanced degree is a plus. Preferred Qualifications Experience in financial services, fintech, digital assets, trading technology, or other highly regulated technology environments. Experience supporting organizations undergoing rapid global growth, international expansion, or significant technology transformation. Experience designing IT environments for highly distributed or remote-first organizations. Familiarity with modern cloud-native architectures, SaaS ecosystems, Zero Trust principles, automation, and AI-enabled enterprise productivity. Experience partnering with Security, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, and Operations leadership at the executive level. Builds trust with executives, engineers, business leaders, and employees. Makes sound decisions in complex and rapidly changing environments. Is highly accountable and comfortable operating with significant autonomy. Can balance security, resilience, scalability, employee experience, and cost efficiency. Builds strong teams and develops future technology leaders. Thrives in a fast-paced, global, and entrepreneurial environment. Why FalconX At FalconX, technology is foundational to our mission of building the infrastructure that enables institutional participation in digital asset markets.
